Our Services
Insulation Solutions for Your Home
Insulation Expertise You Can Rely On
Our insulation professionals assess your home and recommend practical solutions for comfort and energy efficiency.
We explain your options, answer your questions, and keep you informed throughout your insulation project.
Our team uses proven installation methods and insulation materials suited to your home and its needs.
We value your time and comfort, offering efficient services while treating your home with care. We promise to leave your space in better condition than we found it.
We review the completed installation and answer your questions so you know what to expect from your insulation upgrade.
From winter drafts to summer heat, we help homeowners choose insulation solutions for year-round comfort.

What Our Customers Say
About Koala Insulation
Explore insulation solutions designed to help reduce drafts, manage indoor temperatures, and improve year-round comfort.
Take the next step toward a more comfortable home. Request a free insulation evaluation today.
Let Our Insulation Experts Show You The Many Benefits Of Our High Performance Insulation.
Choose insulation that’s better for your home and the planet, such as solar-powered attic fans.
Stay cozy inside, no matter the weather outside.
Save on your energy bills while keeping your home comfy all year.
We use top-quality insulation to give you lasting results.
Ready to Make Your Home More Comfortable?
Get expert advice on insulation, air sealing, and attic ventilation. Schedule a free insulation evaluation with Koala Insulation.

Keep your home comfortable through Canadian winters and summers. Koala Insulation offers spray foam, blown-in insulation, batt insulation, insulation removal, and solar attic fans to help improve comfort and energy efficiency.
Learn why insulation is critical to your home’s energy efficiency and your family’s comfort.

page_meta.hero_form_heading: Talk to Our Insulation Experts Today.

We have a proven track record for delivering reliable and cost efficient insulation solutions that makes us a trusted choice for homeowners and businesses across the nation.
page_meta.why_accordion_1_description: We prioritize our customers with a focus on providing excellent support and personalized service for every project. With over 13,000 positive reviews, we are dedicated to ensuring a customer-friendly, stress-free and cost efficient experience for every customer.
